text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 电影场景第2批 · 17 · 画室里未完成的春天.
Environment:  A modest 19th-century young artist's studio with high north-facing windows, ivory plaster walls, pale aged wood floor and exposed beams. Two easels to left hold unfinished landscapes and botanical studies only, a wooden paint trolley with modest pigments, linen cloth, ceramic pitcher with a few white flowers, one empty plain chair. Tall shelves with canvas backs, open rear door toward a bright interior landing. Art-making traces feel specific and warm, center floor open, fine paint smears and natural dust visible, no portrait art, no statues or anatomical casts.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent orthographic overhead CONCEPT PLAN. Depict footprint, connected zones, wall thickness, doors, windows, stairs, furniture footprints and circulation. For outdoors use a site plan of paths, terrain, bridges and water instead of domestic rooms. North is only design orientation. Compact labels; no invented metric dimensions. Flat diagram on white background.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Scene: 电影场景第2批 · 17 · 画室里未完成的春天. Create ONE clear TRUE FLAT 2D floor plan or outdoor site plan reconstructing this exact reference scene, for staging and spatial understanding. Show only this location and immediate footprint, not a whole unrelated complex. Preserve distinctive architecture, openings, landmarks and furniture positions. Infer unseen bounds conservatively, mark inferred extension dashed. Black technical lines on white, pale zone fills, wall thickness, door arcs, windows, furniture horizontal footprint symbols, outdoor paths/water/terrain where relevant. North arrow is conceptual sheet orientation. No perspective, no raised walls, no fake dimension/scale numbers, no people or animals. Small English zone labels, title CONCEPT PLAN, large uncluttered plan. Good proportions and connected walkable passages. Landscape format.
